live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

experiment.prespecified: Fixed 2026-11-23, before any result of this build was read (borg-zoo#729; borg-reborn-rs #1109). Two arms on f0e13e99 (class files as shipped): ctl0 (explore_breadth_first 0, the control) and bfs1 (explore_breadth_first 1 with the shipped class-specific HP thresholds), same race, class, seed, birth configuration and cap in each pair. This is the first stage of the request: the 18 classes-18 starts at the usual cap (100,000 turns) to check the collection, evidence retained (state, messages, return events, native town receipts, town plan records). Not run here: the matched long-cap stage at 2,200,000 engine turns, which needs the two incident Mage starts of #1109 and independent Mage starts from an owner-approved unused seed block (asked for on the issue). Primary endpoint (prespecified): food-driven town returns per 100,000 dungeon turns, from native return reasons and depth transitions, generic restock apart unless driven by food; per-start paired results, counts of completed trips and food-driven returns, durations in engine turns with unfinished trips marked. Also: store purchases matched to 'You bought ... for ... gold' receipts, Home withdrawals counted apart; transactions, copies, nutrition and retail gold by kind; departures joined to the final town-plan leave record (paction 7, capability_curves nutrition row index 1: demand in column 2, supply in column 3, in thousandths; set-to items like Remove Hunger 35 shown apart from additive food: biscuit 10, ration 30); the departure stock against the planner's demand, the offers and the trip duration; observed Hungry/Weak events and biscuit use; cases where a trip exhausted food despite departing with enough stock; whether each arm actually used dark-bfs; early stops kept and reported. Gate: no config_error; one binary; each arm's values in params-core.json; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped. Descriptive (RULES 14).
